regressionFinding.finding: The public route formerly reached the loader-bearing successor through a raw.githack redirect. Direct-route restoration recovered the H-Earth page but did not carry forward arrival-loader.js or its pre-render import.

visualReview.reviewMethod: Exact recovered source identity plus source-level visual comparison against the repository visual proxy
observations: The loader is a temporary full-viewport maritime-dark arrival surface labeled H-Earth live world initialization and Entering the coast.
Its single-card composition remains visually subordinate to the canonical world and introduces no dashboard, map, parallel world, or duplicate product.
The loader fades and removes itself only after READY_PUBLISHED, revealing the unchanged H-Earth ground world.
Reduced-motion users retain the same semantic startup information without animated transitions.

continuityProof.wrapperDelta: One import: await import('../arrival-loader.js'); immediately after renderer-startup-observer.v1.js and before public-live-gpu-integration.run8e-r3e.js.
continuityProof.legacyImmediateMotionProbeDisposition: The CP3D exact-head probe independently proved renderer startup, first-frame presentation, and READY_PUBLISHED, then reported too few programmatic touch presentations because it begins its 1.2-second motion window while the restored historical ready fade is still active. This is a verifier-assumption mismatch for the intentionally restored arrival interval, not evidence of renderer startup failure; the exact historical loader behavior remains unchanged.
